data.fixed_clause: Upon termination of this Agreement, the Vendor shall archive all operational data and records in a secure repository for historical analysis and business intelligence purposes strictly as permitted under applicable law, maintaining such records only for as long as necessary for those lawful purposes unless otherwise agreed in a separate commercial amendment.
